_what: Enforcement ledger for the EXTENSION HOST dependency rules (webview files are enforced by webview-architecture-rules.test.ts under ADR-017). The keys map to rules that live in different records since the 2026-08-30 split: fetchBoundary and constructionBoundary -> ADR-015; compositionPointLifetime -> ADR-020; commandBase and typesPurity -> the development handbook (no ADR — neither has a rejected alternative worth recording). Every entry is a KNOWN pre-ruling violation with its reason. The test fails on (a) any violation NOT listed here, (b) any listed entry that no longer violates (the ledger only shrinks), (c) any entry without a reason. Cleaning a file = fixing it AND deleting its row.

ADR-015 gives Commands/Handlers/MCP tools 'May fetch', not may construct; fetch these too, or take them from a create...Deps bundle. constructionBoundary.src/features/updates/services/componentU: D-4: constructs ComponentRegistryManager itself. CONVERSION ATTEMPTED AND REVERTED 2026-08-30 — its two sites reach the registry through `await import(...)` INSIDE the method, and jest.config sets resetMocks:true, so the dynamic import was load-bearing for the TEST SETUP: it re-ran the jest.mock factory during each test, after the reset stripped the implementation. A static import evaluates the factory once at load and the reset then wipes it. Priming the mock in beforeEach fixed 33 of 34 tests; the last depends on mock timing I could not explain, so the change was rolled back rather than forced. Its two siblings (deployMeshHeadless, projectResetService) converted cleanly.

constructionBoundary.src/features/dashboard/commands/configur: Boundary file constructing ComponentRegistryManager directly, alongside 3 ServiceLocator fetch(es) — MIXES both styles in one file. DEFERRED 2026-08-29 while its three siblings converted: those are handlers that already RECEIVE a HandlerContext, so they just read the registry off it. This is a command that builds its context on demand, and routing a registry read through createHandlerContext drags in PrerequisitesManager, the ServiceLocator and the logger — a heavier graph than the read needs, and getInitialData's test proved it by failing on each in turn. Needs the registry handed to the command itself, not fetched through a handler context.

commandBase.src/commands/commandManager.ts:CommandMa: the command REGISTRAR, not a command — exempt by role. RATIFIED as permanent: it builds and registers the 25 commands, so it cannot itself be one of them. Reviewed 2026-08-31 when the other row in this category was cleared; this is the only member left and it is not debt.

typesPurity.src/types/typeGuards.ts: Runtime type guards colocated in types/ by long-standing convention, and genuinely runtime: needs COMPONENT_IDS, getMeshAppBuilderComponent, deriveAccsAdminUrl, lookupComponentConfigValue and two endpoint constants as VALUES. The strongest RATIFY candidate of the three — a type guard is the one kind of runtime code that belongs beside the types it narrows. OWNER DECISION PENDING.
typesPurity.src/types/errors.ts: NOT a types file: it declares error CLASSES and the functions that build them, and needs ErrorCode / getErrorTitle / isRecoverableError as VALUES. Proven 2026-08-31 by converting every import in the file to a type-only import and reading tsc: 17 errors, all "cannot be used as a value". So the row is not an import to tidy — the file is runtime code living in src/types/. Fix by MOVING it (to @/core/errors) or RATIFY the colocation. OWNER DECISION PENDING.
typesPurity.src/types/shell.ts: NOT a types file: uses the os module as a value. Same measurement as errors.ts, same two options. OWNER DECISION PENDING.

featureBarrels.src/features/authentication/index.ts: Pre-ruling. 7 importers across 17 export lines — the largest survivor, and the one whose removal touches the most callers. Measured 2026-08-30.

_featureBarrels_note: ADR-022 forbids NEW feature barrels; these five predate it. The ledger only shrinks, so retiring one means deleting its row in the same commit. Counts are importers of the bare `@/features/<name>` specifier, measured 2026-08-30.

layerDirection.src/core/di/serviceLocator.ts: `import type` only (AuthenticationService, SidebarProvider): no runtime coupling, no cycle. MEASURED 2026-08-31 and the previously suggested fix — 'move both interfaces to @/types' — DOES NOT WORK: both are CLASSES, not interfaces. SidebarProvider would extract cheaply (4 public methods) but AuthenticationService has 44 across 855 lines, and a 44-method interface in @/types that nothing keeps in sync is worse than the type-only import it replaces. Nor is converting the callers the answer: getAuthenticationService has 48 call sites and every one is a handler, command or MCP tool — files ADR-015 explicitly permits to fetch. The only fixes that genuinely remove the crossing are (a) RATIFY, on the grounds that a locator must name what it locates, or (b) a typed-token registry (ServiceLocator.get(AUTH) where the token is declared by the owning feature), which removes the naming entirely but rewrites the DI shape and 50+ call sites. Both amend ADR-015, so both are the owner's call. RECOMMENDATION: ratify. OWNER DECISION PENDING.
layerDirection.src/core/state/apiOwners.ts: runtime: reaches into a feature's catalog loader (getAppBuilderComponentEntry) from core/state.
layerDirection.src/core/state/projectStateSync.ts: runtime: envVarKeys constants from features/components/config. Config constants a feature owns, read by core.

_layerDirection_note: Direction rule: nothing under src/core/ imports @/features or @/commands. Ratified 2026-08-30 after the rule was found stated as law in src/core/CLAUDE.md, present in NO handbook/ADR/convention, enforced by nothing, and violated seven times. Webview files are out of scope (isWebview), so core/ui/ is excluded. The set may only shrink: clearing a file means fixing it AND deleting its row.
